source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
With **DRUKHARI** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), your army can contain **HARLEQUINS** and **ANHRATHE** units without the **DRUKHARI** Faction keyword, worth at most these points in total for each [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size):

- **Incursion**: 250 pts
- **Strike Force**: 500 pts
- **Onslaught**: 750 pts

None of the **HARLEQUINS** or **ANHRATHE** models added like this can be your **WARLORD** or get Enhancements.
